isOutdated.title: Older Client
isOutdated.message: You can ignore this message as your client will still work! Though, there is a new version available. Update for the best experience! You will be notified when this build of the client is no longer supported.

denyAccess.title: Time to Update
denyAccess.message: This version of Nautilus Client has known issues which have been fixed in later builds. Please update to continue using Nautilus. Thank you for understanding.
